purpose: Minimize the trusted code/configuration surface that can directly authorize or block an HF01 empirical claim.
kernel_rules: Only normative-kernel components may directly determine empirical claim acceptance.
Diagnostic/advisory components may produce warnings, optimization suggestions or test attacks but must not silently upgrade authority.
A change to any normative-kernel dependency invalidates certificates bound to the previous kernel revision.
Adding a new normative component requires a documented failure class that cannot be blocked by the existing kernel.
invariant: Minimize the authority-bearing trusted computing base; keep research exploration outside the proof kernel by default.
